facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A man had a horse. Hans liked the horse. He gave his gold. He traded it away.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: A man on a horse stopped and asked about the heavy gold. Hans said the gold was too heavy to carry all the way. He traded it away, giving the gold for a horse. Hans was thrilled because riding was so much easier. He did not realize the gold was worth much more. But Hans felt happy and that was all that mattered.
facts.Word cards: gave = 줬다 / away = 멀리 / stone = 돌 / light = 가벼운
